purpose: Promotion Bakeoff probe set (shared/cross_model_verification.md § Promotion Bakeoff): 30 references — 20 real (10 easy DOI-keyed journal articles; 10 hard: arXiv preprints, DOI-less conference papers, non-English articles) + 10 synthetic plausible fabrications. Every real row was resolver-confirmed on 2026-08-19 (Crossref direct DOI lookup, arXiv API id lookup, or live papers.nips.cc fetch); every fabricated row was negative-checked against Crossref bibliographic search on the same day.

labels.real: the work exists; ground_truth records the confirmed identifier
